svg.title: A day in the mountains, lights following the sky
svg.desc: ASCII animation: the camera rises from a desk to a mountain range and goes through dawn, sun, passing clouds, rain, a storm with yellow lightning, alpenglow and night, while an LED strip copies the color of the sky.
